selectionTrigger: User preferred Texture+25 for flamingo feathers and reflected legs and preferred combined appearance overall; ripples remained indistinguishable. This permits the planned conditional skin/foliage review, without changing the candidate or strengths.

selectionPolicy.sourceOnly: Unchanged source originals, prior Neutral production views and original native crops only; no supplemental Texture output viewed.
selectionPolicy.noAfterOutputTuning: Do not move masks/crops, change strengths/feather/support, substitute sources or drop unfavorable controls after output. Any revision requires separate versioned evidence.
selectionPolicy.amounts: Same frozen modest -25/0/+25 and declared stress -100/+100; no tuning or automatic method cycle.
selectionPolicy.viewing: Each integer 512x512 crop has one source-grid pixel per PNG pixel; source-overview resizing is for location/privacy review only.
selectionPolicy.scope: Two supplemental sources, one analytic radial mask per source, neutral point edits/AsShot, complete native source filtering before proof and crop. No feature enablement, general stack, tiling, merge correctness or physical HDR acceptance.
